dedupe_keys.name: dynust dynamic traffic assignment model with dynustudio

description: DynusT is a simulation-based dynamic traffic assignment (DTA) model. Its website describes it as an agent-based behaviour simulation that applies a micro-like mesoscopic vehicular traffic simulation, able to simulate a wide range of operational planning scenarios and to run daily simulations of large-scale regional models. DynuStudio is its companion interface for visualisation and analysis; version 3.0 of DynusT and DynuStudio lists new methods and features. Coverage: generic; the site cites more than 200 projects and publications by users worldwide and more than 20 transportation agencies using it for mission-critical modelling. Format and access: desktop software described on the vendor website. Licence and cost: licence terms and prices are not stated on the homepage. Caveats: claims of use are the vendor's own; input formats are not described on the homepage read. The model supports network flow, agent-based and capacity planning studies of regional road networks, including disruption scenarios where time-dependent rerouting matters. It relates to DTALite, TransCAD and Aimsun Next in the catalogue.
